description: Virgo decan 3 (September 13 to September 22): personality, love, work and growth, with Venus as sub-ruler of the third ten degrees of Virgo.
answer: In Western astrology, the third decan of Virgo covers 20° to 29° of the sign, roughly September 13 to September 22, with Venus as its sub-ruler beside Mercury. It is read as gentle perfectionism aimed at beauty, kindness and the finishing touch. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Virgo decan 3 personality
paragraphs: In the closing degrees of Virgo the sub-ruler is Venus, the planet associated with Taurus, and its touch shows up as taste. Third-decan Virgos are often described as gentle perfectionists whose high standards are aimed at beauty as much as correctness. They are the friend who straightens a crooked picture without comment, chooses exactly the right card and notices when the light in a room feels harsh. Practical skill and a sense of proportion tend to work together in them, which makes for elegant solutions rather than merely efficient ones. Kindness, quietly delivered, is one of their most recognisable traits.

Venus brings more ease with pleasure than Virgo usually allows itself. These natives often enjoy good food, gardens, fabrics and small rituals of comfort, and they can be more openly affectionate than their earlier-decan siblings. The Venus emphasis also tilts them towards harmony, which has a cost: they may agree to things they resent, or polish their appearance and manners until they feel exhausted by the effort. Older decan traditions linked this stretch with refinement and the finishing touch. Their best work frequently comes from blending care for people with care for detail, so that usefulness and loveliness arrive together.

sections.heading: Virgo decan 3 in love and at work
paragraphs: Third-decan Virgos are often the most romantic members of their sign, though their romance is understated. They court with handwritten notes, carefully chosen gifts and evenings planned down to the playlist. Tenderness comes more easily than for many Virgos, and so does a wish for a calm, pleasant home life. Insecurity can surface as self-criticism, especially about whether they are attractive or interesting enough. A partner who offers sincere, specific compliments and reciprocates their thoughtfulness usually finds a devoted, gentle companion who keeps improving the shared life in small, lovely ways.

Work that marries precision with taste tends to suit this decan best. Interior and graphic design, tailoring, horticulture, copy-editing, patisserie, beauty therapy, curation and patient-facing care all draw on the blend of Venus and Virgo. They are often the person who makes a report readable, a shop window inviting or a clinic waiting room less bleak. Colleagues appreciate their tact. What they sometimes neglect is self-advocacy: their contributions are so smoothly delivered that others underestimate the effort. Keeping a record of results and naming them at review time helps.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Virgo decan 3: what Venus adds
paragraphs: The third decan covers 20° to 29° of Virgo, which in most years means birthdays from September 13 to September 22. Its sub-ruler, Venus, comes from Taurus, the last earth sign after Virgo, so this decan borrows a little of Taurus's character while staying Virgo at heart. The other two decans of Virgo belong to Mercury (decan 1) and Saturn (decan 2). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Venus contributes charm, taste and a pull towards harmony. Its decans tend to be pictured as more sociable and aesthetic, alert to beauty and fairness, and keen to soften conflict through diplomacy, pleasure and good company. Venusian decans are often linked with art, hospitality, partnership and style, and their usual lesson is to say what they want rather than smooth it over. Set against Virgo's precision, helpfulness, practical intelligence and a love of improvement, that Venus note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Virgo decan 3
paragraphs: The growth edge here usually involves telling the truth kindly instead of keeping the peace quietly. Try voicing one small disagreement a week and noticing that warmth survives it. When the urge to please appears, it can help to ask what would be chosen if nobody were watching. Accepting a compliment with a simple thank you, rather than a correction, is good practice. Making something beautiful purely for oneself, a meal, a garden corner or a sketch, can remind this decan that Venus pleasure belongs to the maker too, not only to the people being looked after.

Within Virgo, decan 1 leans towards the sign's analytical engine, sharp-eyed and quietly useful and decan 2 leans towards conscientious craft and slow mastery under saturn's steady discipline. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: What does Venus add to the third decan of Virgo?
faq.answer: Venus, linked with Taurus, is the sub-ruler of Virgo's closing degrees. It is read as adding grace, warmth and an eye for beauty to the sign's precision. These natives are often described as the most refined and affectionate Virgos, combining practical skill with taste, though they may struggle to put their own needs first.

faq.question: What are the dates of Virgo decan 3?
faq.answer: In most years September 13 to September 22, the days when the Sun is between 20° and 29° of Virgo. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Virgo decan 3?
faq.answer: Venus. In the triplicity system each earth sign's decans take the rulers of the earth signs in order, starting with Virgo's own ruler, Mercury.
